import json, random, sys

def build(seed=1, natoms=20, K=8, ntrain=4096, nprobe=128, nquery=1024, nsrc=4):
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    fields = [{"name":"bytes","type":"SIZE","min":0,"max":100000},
              {"name":"packets","type":"COUNT","min":0,"max":10000},
              {"name":"proto","type":"ID","values":["tcp","udp","icmp"]},
              {"name":"syn","type":"FLAG"}]
    atoms=[]
    for i in range(natoms):
        kind = i % 5
        f = fields[i % len(fields)]
        if kind == 0:
            atoms.append({"cmp":"ge","left":{"field":"bytes","at":i%K},"right":{"const":rng.randint(0,500),"type":"SIZE"}})
        elif kind == 1:
            atoms.append({"cmp":"lt","left":{"field":"packets","at":i%K},"right":{"const":rng.randint(1,50),"type":"COUNT"}})
        elif kind == 2:
            atoms.append({"cmp":"eq","left":{"field":"proto","at":i%K},"right":{"const":"tcp","type":"ID"}})
        elif kind == 3:
            atoms.append({"cmp":"eq","left":{"field":"syn","at":i%K},"right":{"const":True,"type":"FLAG"}})
        else:
            lo=i%K; hi=min(K-1, lo+1)
            atoms.append({"quantifier":"any","from":lo,"to":hi,
                          "predicate":{"cmp":"ge","left":{"field":"bytes","at":"$"},"right":{"const":rng.randint(0,200),"type":"SIZE"}}})
    def trace(tid, src, nrows):
        rows=[]
        t=0
        for i in range(nrows):
            rows.append({"t":t,"values":[rng.randint(0,1000), rng.randint(0,100), rng.choice(["tcp","udp","icmp"]), rng.choice([True,False])]})
            t+=rng.randint(1,3)
        return {"id":tid,"source":src,"rows":rows}
    train=[]; total=0; i=0
    while total < ntrain + K:
        n = ntrain // 4 + 1
        tr = trace("t%d"%i, "s%d"%(i%nsrc), n); train.append(tr); total += n-K+1; i+=1
    probes=[]; total=0; i=0
    while total < nprobe:
        n = nprobe // 2 + 1
        tr = trace("p%d"%i, "s0", n); probes.append(tr); total += n-K+1; i+=1
    queries=[]; total=0; i=0
    while total < nquery:
        n = nquery // 2 + 1
        tr = trace("q%d"%i, "s0", n); queries.append(tr); total += n-K+1; i+=1
    return {"version":1,"schema":fields,"window":K,"atoms":atoms,
            "policy":{"max_width":4,"min_support":2,"min_witness":2},
            "train":train,"probes":probes,"queries":queries}

if __name__=="__main__":
    req = build()
    sys.stdout.write(json.dumps(req))
PYEOF
